title: A starting download shows the Download started notification and a failed download shows Failed to download report
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Technician Utilization report with rows loaded.
2. You can force a download failure (e.g. drop the network connection just before triggering the download).
custom_steps:
1. Trigger a normal download and read the notification.
2. Trigger a download under the failure condition and read the notification.
custom_expected:
1. When a download starts, a success notification reads exactly: "Download started".
2. When a download fails, an error notification reads exactly: "Failed to download report".
